assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: README style reference; intended use: A six-style comparison of this individual source photograph for the Art Skill README
Primary request: An upward view of a warm beige building with a diagonal roofline, a slim roof railing and red-trimmed windows in the lower part of the frame, beneath a vast blue sky, a small soft white cloud and a faint rainbow patch. Small foliage sits along the lower edge.
Style/medium: gestural pencil and ink drawing with sparse color accents
Color palette: #F4EFE4, #2D2926, #B96843, #6A8072
Materials/textures: paper tooth, varied line weight, restrained graphite smudges
Composition/framing: loose energetic marks around a clearly structured subject; Keep portrait orientation and the original broad framing; one image, no frame or panels
Lighting/mood: soft implied light with selective crosshatching
Requested output target: 1024x1536, opaque background, png; use only supported tool controls
Avoid: real people; copyrighted characters; logos and brand marks; copied artworks; unrequested lettering
Constraints: Keep the original upward viewpoint, diagonal building line, window rhythm, broad empty sky, small cloud placement and faint rainbow motif. Do not add a sea, mountains, a garden terrace or a sunset.; No added people, brands, characters, captions or signatures; Use only this source photograph as the composition reference; never mix motifs from the other photos
